text: API Design & Integration
REST API Specifications
The API must follow RESTful principles with proper HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH).

text: Authentication & Authorization
All API endpoints must require API key authentication or JWT bearer tokens.
Rate limiting must be enforced: 1000 requests per minute per API key for standard tier, 10000 per minute for premium tier.

text: Data Validation & Error Handling
All request payloads must be validated against defined JSON schemas with detailed error messages for validation failures.
API must handle gracefully error scenarios including null references, type mismatches, and missing required fields.

text: Performance & Pagination
List endpoints must support pagination with limit (max 100) and offset parameters.
API responses must include metadata (total_count, page, page_size, has_next) for pagination support.
Implement query result caching for read-only endpoints with configurable TTL (Time To Live) up to 24 hours.
